Methods Clinical pharmacists participated in the treatment of a child with nephrotic syndrome complicated with Hp infection，optimized the medication regimen，and reduced adverse drug interactions through rapid access to pharmaceutical information. Results and conclusion The child improved and was discharged from hospital. Clinical pharmacists timely warned the possible drug interaction between omeprazole and clarithromycin and tacrolimus，maintaining the efficacy of tacrolimus in the treatment of nephrotic syndrome and avoiding serious drug interactions.( 1. a.
